title: AlertEvent v1
description: Canonical alert (doc 05 §5.2). Carried as `data` inside a CloudEvents 1.0 envelope (source //aegisbastion/<module>, type com.aegisbastion.alert.v1) on the <module>.alert subjects. Validation rules beyond the shape: `occurred_at` must be within ±24 h of ingest (checked at ingest, not expressible here); payload max 64 KiB — larger evidence goes to object storage and is referenced by URL. `authorization_token_id` is the jti of a gatekeeper-issued Scope Token (doc 11 §3.2); it is MANDATORY when source_module is ddos-engine or ai-redteam, or when category ∈ (vuln, exposure) with confidence = confirmed from an active scan (the conditional below encodes the statically checkable part).

schema_version.description: Contract version — fixed "1.0" for AlertEvent v1.

source_event_id.description: Id of the originating module event (e.g. the MonitorChange chg_… or FindingReport fnd_…).

authorization_token_id.description: jti of the gatekeeper Scope Token (doc 11 §3.2) that authorized the underlying activity. Mandatory for ddos-engine / ai-redteam sources and for confirmed active-scan vuln/exposure alerts (see allOf below). Passive-derived alerts carry the RoE id instead and are marked confidence: probable until an authorized probe confirms (doc 03 §5.3).

fingerprint_hint.description: Producer-side dedup hint, e.g. "cve-2024-3094|asset_88f3|443/tcp". Monitor sets this to the MonitorChange fingerprint with dedup_window_seconds 86400 (doc 03 §5.3).

asset_id.description: Asset id from the data platform, e.g. "asset_88f3".

evidence.description: Compact evidence: {scanner, proof, references}. Large evidence lives in object storage and is referenced by URL (payload ≤ 64 KiB).

occurred_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp; must be within ±24 h of ingest.

renotify_every.description: Re-notification interval in seconds; 0 = never renotify.

allOf.description: authorization_token_id is mandatory for ddos-engine and ai-redteam sources (doc 05 §5.2).
authorization_token_id is mandatory for confirmed vuln/exposure alerts from active scans (doc 05 §5.2, §13.1; Ruling C8 for detect.alert; doc 03 §5.3 for monitor.alert exposure alerts).
